Priya: Drafting customer comms for a rolling maintenance on 2024-11-12. NA / EU / APAC waves, 2h each. Sharing status + email copy for review.

Alex: Add a clear 'no data loss' line and link to rollback runbook. Also call out behavior for Dedicated pinned versions.

Priya: Will add both. Draft status snippet: 

Priya: "Status: Scheduled rolling maintenance. Windows (UTC) - NA 02:00-04:00, EU 06:00-08:00, APAC 12:00-14:00. Impact: Temporary latency spikes and 20-40% reduced throughput during restarts. No data loss expected. Pinned Dedicated model versions will not be auto-upgraded. Action: Live updates on https://status.redwood.ai; contact eng-oncall@redwood.ai for urgent needs."

Jin: Suggest a fallback sentence: requests may be routed to alternate regions or compatible model variants if capacity constrained.

Kate: Also add: 'No SLO changes expected; short impacts only during restarts.' And include ops contact in email body.

Priya: Email subject draft: "Planned maintenance: rolling infra updates  Nov 12 (UTC)". Body short: 

Priya: "Hi <customer>,
We will perform rolling maintenance on Nov 12 across NA, EU, and APAC. During restarts you may see short latency spikes and reduced throughput; we expect no data loss and pinned model versions will be preserved. If you need guaranteed capacity during these windows, reply and we'll discuss options. Live updates will be posted on https://status.redwood.ai.
Thanks, Redwood Support"

deploy-bot: Statuspage event created: evt-20241112-001 (staging). Use `/status-publish evt-20241112-001` when ready.

Alex: Pre-publish checklist: 1) Canary smoke tests per region 2) kv-cache snapshot 3) Include rollback runbook link 4) Support to notify top-10 customers individually.

Jin: I'll run #1 and #2; smoke tests queued for NA at T-1h.

Priya: I'll assemble top-10 list and the individualized email template.

Kate: I'll QA the staging statuspage and publish at T-15m if green.

Priya: Staging link: https://status.staging.redwood.ai/incidents/evt-20241112-001

Alex: LGTM. Support team please prepare the send list and schedule.

Kate: Staging QA done, minor grammar tweak. Ready to publish at T-15m pending go/no-go.

Priya: Holding final publish until T-15m. Will post the go/no-go here. :thumbsup:
